mask.title: Mask URL
mask.description: The mask URL to inpaint the image. MUST have the exact same dimensions (width and height) as the input image.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the random number generator

image.title: Image URL
image.description: The image URL to generate an image from. MUST have the exact same dimensions (width and height) as the mask image.

images.title: Image Urls
images.description: A set of images to use as style references (maximum total size 10MB across all style references). The images should be in JPEG, PNG or WebP format

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to fill the masked part of the image.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Ideogram 3.0 Edit

Ideogram 3.0 edit: inpaint a masked region of an image from a prompt.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text instruction. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | Image to edit. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `images` | image URL[] | — | Optional style references. |
| `mask` | image URL | — | Area to edit. |
| `rendering_speed` | `TURBO` / `BALANCED` / `QUALITY` | `BALANCED` | Sets the per-image rate. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

Per image: $0.03 Turbo, $0.06 Balanced, $0.09 Quality.

| Speed | Price |
|---|---|
| TURBO | $0.03 |
| BALANCED | $0.06 |
| QUALITY | $0.09 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Quote all text that must appear.
